profile.name: Yi-Cheng
profile.intro:
{age} 🏳️‍🌈. I spent over three years working as a software engineer, and I’m now on my way to becoming a therapist. 
I’ve stumbled, lost my way, and taken many wrong turns along the road. 
But now, I want to become more like myself—more like Yicheng.
